source: All images are real, unmodified full-page or region screenshots captured live via Chrome DevTools from the deployed public demo (https://iederees-create.github.io/precision-laser-works-template/), except image 10 which is a screenshot of the actual rendered buyer-file 02-START-HERE.html included in this release's buyer package. No stock imagery, no mockups, no AI-generated UI. Video files are silent slideshows assembled with ffmpeg directly from these same real screenshots (no screen-recording tool was available in this environment) — each frame is a genuine, unaltered product screenshot, held for a fixed duration and concatenated; no synthetic/fabricated frames were used.

images.description: Cover — hero section, Graphite Laser theme (default)
Mobile homepage (390x844 CSS viewport, 2x device pixel ratio)
Laser Cut & Engraving Quote Planner — empty form
Material, thickness, dimensions and quantity inputs
File-preparation checklist in a completed Planner result
Full quote summary panel: area, quantity, complexity, budget range
Explicit-confirmation modal shown before any WhatsApp/email send
Cyan Blueprint theme applied via the live theme selector
Rendered 02-START-HERE.html buyer guide, showing what's included and how to configure it

videos.construction: 8 real screenshots (cover, desktop homepage, planner form, material inputs, file-prep checklist, quote summary, confirm modal, theme switch), each padded to a 1080x1080 canvas and shown for 1.8s, concatenated with ffmpeg. Silent, under Etsy's 100MB limit.
videos.verify_before_upload: Confirm current Etsy video requirements (format/length/size) at upload time, since platform requirements can change.

videos.construction: All 9 homepage/planner screenshots (mobile included), each padded to a 1920x1080 canvas and shown for 4s, concatenated with ffmpeg.
